description.value: Starting at 14th level, whenever the summoner casts a summoning spell, he increases the duration by a number of rounds equal to half his summoner level (rounded down). This increase is not doubled by Extend Spell. At 20th level, once per day the summoner can change the duration of a single summon monster class feature or Summon Monster line spell to permanent. If the permanent creatures are killed the summoner may reuse this ability 1 hour later. The summoner can only ever have 1 permanent summon active at one time.
